description: Calf and thigh servos that fire on your reflexes, not your fatigue. You move before the meat around you has decided to.

failure_messages.burnout: A gear strips somewhere in the thigh, and the leg answers half a beat late from now on.
failure_messages.dead: Both actuators shut down. You're walking on meat and bone, and it feels like wading.
failure_messages.fault: The knee servo loses synchronisation. Your leg goes out from under you mid-stride.
failure_messages.strain: The servos in your legs whine on every step, and the heat of them climbs behind your knees.

name: Sprint Actuators
